premise_review: Retain the complete TMFContract. Spectrum and RingOfTopologicalModularForms are independent Type_ fields with no spectrum/ring operations or laws. hasStringOrientation is an unproved Prop, while hasWittenGenus is an independently chosen Prop with a supplied proof; no orientation or genus map is a field of T.

WittenGenusWitness genuinely supplies independent Domain/Codomain types and genus : Domain → Codomain, but modularityWitness : Prop is bare and unproved. It is neither a proof term nor a defined modularity property of genus. Keep the actual function and all fields exact, rather than narrowing the mixed record to only its function data.

TMFTorsionFraming retains its exact tmf : TMFContract, TorsionClass : Type_, torsionOrder? : Option Nat, framingAnomaly : Prop and independent trivialized : Prop with proof. The optional order is metadata, not a proved additive order/cardinality; no group, torsion class element, framing or relation among anomaly/trivialized/order is defined.

Both theorem bodies are genuine exact proofs under their supplied record premises: T.hasWittenGenus_certified and F.trivialized_certified. Neither constructs a genus, modular form, TMF spectrum, framing, string orientation, torsion relation or trivialization from geometric data.
The independent WittenGenusWitness function is not linked by any source field/equation to TMFContract.hasWittenGenus or TMFTorsionFraming.tmf. No relationship is inferred from repeated names.

All three whole own-provider mixed records and both exact conditional proofs remain archival. No field dropping, narrowed function-data schema, new legacy self-provider import, alias, provider replacement or topological/modular law is introduced. The explicit source uses only builtin type/function/Prop/Option/Nat/String syntax under its unresolved Folder.Basic import.
